current_slide.generation_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational / productivity-visual.
Create a NEW, beautifully art-directed Chinese academic research infographic for a single widescreen slide. This is a CONTINUOUS SYSTEM MAP and research story, with interconnected flows across the whole canvas, NOT a dashboard, NOT cards, NOT four quadrants, NOT a collection of separate infographic modules.
Canvas 2.05:1 landscape, high resolution. Pure white, deep navy typography, medium blue thin arrows and selected keywords, restrained red only for decisions and final improvement. A clean editorial scientific schematic inspired by excellent paper visual abstracts. FLAT precise vector-like linework, tiny elegant line symbols only when helpful. NO glossy 3D objects, NO giant books, NO blue glass platforms, NO robotic brain, NO pictorial server piles, NO giant numbered section headings, NO rounded rectangular panels, NO separate card backgrounds. Generous whitespace with deliberate hierarchy and coherent reading direction. Text must stay legible at presentation size. Use disciplined alignment and short labels. There is NO page title; one is placed above this body in PowerPoint.

INTEGRATED COMPOSITION:
The page reads as one connected scientific system: a modest human-and-rules rail at top (about 20% height), one broad autonomous experiment cycle through the middle (about 49%), and real outcomes along the bottom (about 28%). These are linked layers, not boxed bands. No dividing frames. All outside margins generous enough so no text clips.

TOP: At left a very small tasteful navy person/compass line icon with bold text "人类定方向" and smaller text "目标 · 验收 · 授权 · 关键取舍". To its right a short blue arrow labelled "明确长期偏好 / 纠正", leading to an understated rule document marker labelled "AGENTS.md" (not an enormous book).
Under the AGENTS label, exact compact text:
"协作边界 · 验证与收尾 · 行文习惯"
"中文、直白、简报关键发现"
A short fine baseline below it says "查原条款 → 合并修订 → 后续遵循".
Far right a small red boundary notation "越出边界 → 先确认".
A thin blue downward arrow from AGENTS to the experiment cycle carries "边界内自主推进".
A thin return arc from the right side of the experiment cycle back to the human at top-left carries "结果反馈 → 人机讨论 → 优化规则".
Small subdued text under the preference-update rail: "明确长期偏好与纠正才固化；单次选择不自动升级".
Make the human, rules, autonomy, and feedback visibly connected.

CENTER: The main visual is ONE elegant wide loop of experimentation and knowledge. Across the upper half of this middle zone, five ordered stations joined by continuous blue arrows, left to right. Use short bold labels and a tiny line icon above each, NO enclosing boxes:
1 "检索相关经验" / "按需追溯记录与证据"
2 "设计实验" / "假设 · 基线 · 变量 · 预算"
3 "复用已有证据" / "仅变化或异常处定向补验"
4 "后台执行" / "实现 · 并行实验"
5 "约定验收" / "最终候选全量验收"
Below these stations the loop returns from right to left through the project's external memory. A smooth line from "约定验收" descends to the rightmost small evidence-sheet symbol, then flows left to records, then to lessons, then rises back to "检索相关经验". This forms ONE coherent cycle.
Rightmost lower memory label:
"原始证据"
"结果目录：配置 · 指标 · 核心日志"
Lower middle-right:
"实验记录 records/"
"研究主题 × 日期"
"假设 · 配置 · 结果 · 下一步"
Lower middle-left:
"可复用经验 lessons/"
"按问题主题"
"条件 · 证据 · 动作 · 边界"
The two links between records and lessons should have opposite arrow directions: records→lessons labelled "提炼新增认识"; lessons→records labelled "引用来源". Both visible, fine, not crossing text.
The connector from evaluation into records carries the small phrase "回写结果，检查经验增量".
A small line under this memory path reads "成功、失败、中止均记 records；无新增经验则注明".
At the far lower-left of this central region, a small quiet side annotation with a minimal grey archive icon: "history/：旧计划、旧审查，仅供追溯". It is not a success/failure classification.
A blue compact example along the outer return curve to the first station: "10/15 复用 RoPE 修复，仅补加载与迁移检查".
Make the meaning and arrows readable, not a web of crossing lines. No redundant captions.

BOTTOM: The downward consequence of the central experiment cycle flows into a refined full-width five-point experimental milestone line. The connecting line is a restrained navy/blue horizontal research timeline with tiny dots; no steep marketing growth arrow, no decorative cubes, no chart axes. Add small elegant heading at its upper left "真实推进 · Qwen3-8B 原 69% 目标阶段".
At its upper right use bold red "+7.983 个百分点" and below smaller text "2.457 bpw（目标投影）".
Five evenly spaced milestone groups on the same baseline, all EXACT:
"10/1" / "61.330%" / "纯 CAT 起点"
"10/2" / "66.576%" / "逐类压缩恢复"
"10/3" / "67.130%" / "CE50 / CE10 互补组合"
"10/4" / "67.805%" / "配对验证后组合"
"10/4" / "69.313%" / "L0 down 联合恢复"
Values are the strongest typography in this timeline; final value red. All five values readable, no overlap.
A small tasteful speech annotation near the start of the timeline says "10/1 人机讨论：训练期可融合，成品无外置 LoRA".
A thin grey short branch after milestone2 ends with "未改善 → 留证退役", showing negative evidence is retained without another large object.
Bottom discreet caption "固定八任务 0-shot · 代表性成品，非单次训练曲线".
Keep all bottom text fully visible.

HIERARCHY: Flow labels and percentages lead the eye; supporting details smaller but fully legible. The whole diagram should feel like one research mechanism with a living feedback loop and its measured outputs, not 3 or 4 assembled panels. Thin consistent strokes, restrained small icons, whitespace, light visual rhythm. No invented data, no omitted human role or writing habits, no omitted records classification. Exact Simplified Chinese labels.
current_slide.correction_prompt:

Edit the supplied continuous Chinese research system diagram. Make ONLY ONE semantic connection correction and preserve the entire existing composition, text, exact numbers, colors, icons, white space and 2.05:1 landscape aspect.

The top blue return arc labelled "结果反馈 → 人机讨论 → 优化规则" currently has its right-hand origin under the red label "越出边界 → 先确认". This is semantically wrong.
Remove ONLY the blue line segment descending from below that red boundary label into the top return arc.
Instead make the origin of that top blue feedback arc visibly connect to the "约定验收" station (the clipboard icon above that label), rising from the top or upper-right of that station into the existing feedback arc. The arc must continue LEFT across the existing y-position, then upward to the human icon on the upper-left. Give it a clearly connected start at evaluation and retain the existing arrowhead pointing to the human. It should unmistakably mean: evaluation results → human discussion → rule refinement.
Keep the RED dashed arrow and red label "越出边界 → 先确认" independent and exactly unchanged; they must not feed into the blue result-feedback arc.
Do NOT alter the other loop: evaluation → raw evidence → records ↔ lessons → experience retrieval. Do not add any crossing lines or pass over text.

Everything else is an invariant: all Chinese text, all 5 metrics 61.330%, 66.576%, 67.130%, 67.805%, 69.313%, +7.983, the dates, bpw, the whole bottom timeline, all original margins and all letters. Do not reflow, resize, crop, add or remove anything else. Preserve flat white/navy/blue academic schematic style. This is a small precise arrow-routing correction, not a redesign.
